verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-automation and web-fetch platform, so per-URL-pattern crawl configuration in a batch job is a fair question for it. The evidence pack does not document any batch crawl job, nor any way to map different crawl configurations to URL patterns. Thousands of concurrent sessions and single-URL fetch to HTML/JSON/markdown are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
